summary: Kickoff for ArborCare Health onboarding with Redwood. Discussed integration points (VPC peering, SSO), security/compliance needs (SOC2, KMS, audit logs), pilot scope and success criteria (latency, cost targets), and next steps for pilot benchmarking and docs share.
transcript:
16:00:02 - David Chen: hey everyone thanks for joining, i'm David from Redwood, i'm the AE on account. quick roll call?
16:00:10 - Sarah Patel: hi sarah here, vp eng at arborcare.
16:00:13 - Miguel Torres: miguel, head of ml ops.
16:00:15 - Priya Nair: priya, security lead.
16:00:20 - Rachel Ortiz: rachel from success, i'll be your CSM. great to meet you all.
16:00:28 - David Chen: awesome, quick agenda: intros, scope, security & networking, pilot timeline, next steps. feel free to interrupt.
16:00:45 - Sarah Patel: sounds good, our main objective is to get a pilot running on some patient anonymized note summarization flows, latency target around 300ms p50 if possible, cost is also a factor.
16:01:02 - Maya Singh: hi all, maya se. couple quick q's up front: are you thinking hosted api first or private/vpc? that'll change the integration pattern.
16:01:15 - Miguel Torres: we prefer private vpc for PHI reasons but open to dedicated hosted if the isolation's solid. compliance team insists on customer-managed keys ideally.
16:01:33 - Priya Nair: yes we need KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, and SOC 2 evidence. also SAML SSO for console access.
16:01:48 - David Chen: ok that's expected. Redwood Private supports VPC peering with customer subnet and KMS integration, we can do HSM via partners. we'll attach SOC 2 and ISO docs after call.
16:02:05 - Sarah Patel: great. for success criteria, aside from latency, we also want 99.9% uptime for the pilot window and clear cost per 1k tokens numbers.
16:02:18 - Rachel Ortiz: we'll capture those in the pilot SLO doc. maya, can you walk through pilot plan?
16:02:25 - Maya Singh: sure. goal is 2-week pilot: week one smoke + functional, week two performance/baseline. we'll run a set of 10K anonymized transcripts, run baseline on your infra and then on Redwood Dedicated + Redwood Private config, compare p50/p95 latency and tokens cost.
16:02:49 - Miguel Torres: when you say "Redwood Dedicated" do we get pinned GPUs or a pool? is that per-commit?
16:02:58 - David Chen: Dedicated is reserved GPU pools w/ predictable throughput, you can commit monthly/annual. for pilot we usually spin up a small dedicated pool to hit perf SLOs.
16:03:12 - Sarah Patel: ok, timeline wise we want pilot results by end of May. is that realistic?
16:03:19 - Maya Singh: yes if we get network access and sample data this week.
16:03:25 - Priya Nair: on network we need IP allowlists and a contact for peering, miguel can provide.
16:03:33 - Miguel Torres: i'll loop in infra, we have a ticketing system, will share contact.
16:03:40 - David Chen: perfect. security notes: we support SAML SSO, RBAC roles in Console, encryption at rest with customer KMS, and audit logs retained per enterprise plan. anything else from compliance?
16:03:57 - Priya Nair: retention policy: can you restrict logs retention to 90 days and export raw logs for audits?
16:04:05 - Rachel Ortiz: yes, enterprise plan supports custom retention and we can provide log exports. we'll add to action items.
16:04:12 - Sarah Patel: regarding model choice, are you recommending an open model or do you host 3rd-party models?
16:04:20 - Maya Singh: we have a model catalog, we can host curated open models or bring your own model. for clinical notes summarization we often start with a 13B LLM tuned for instruction. we can also test Anthropic-ish and OpenAI endpoints for comparison.
16:04:38 - Miguel Torres: do you do quantization? we want cost reduction.
16:04:42 - David Chen: yes, Redwood Optimize gives quantization and batching recommendations; SE will propose quant profiles for the pilot. sometimes quantization impacts quality so we'll run evals.
16:04:55 - Sarah Patel: excellent. any concerns about PII in embedding indices? we'll probably use embeddings for search later.
16:05:03 - Maya Singh: for embeddings we recommend vector encryption and namespace isolation. also prefix KV cache is optional; small transcription note - sometimes transcripts call it coach cache, it's actually KV cache.
16:05:18 - Miguel Torres: haha yeah we saw that in previous calls.
16:05:22 - David Chen: thanks for flagging. on the integration side, we need a service account, key exchange for VPC, and a test dataset. rachel will send the access request form.
16:05:34 - Rachel Ortiz: i'll send that after this call, plus the onboarding runbook and a secure link to SOC2 docs.
16:05:43 - Priya Nair: can we get a pen test report or references?
16:05:48 - David Chen: we can provide a summary and redacted pen test. i'll follow up.
16:05:54 - Sarah Patel: ok, let's talk pilot success metrics - latency p50 300ms, p95 under 800ms, quality score >= 4.2 on your eval rubric, and cost per 1k tokens under $2. Is that feasible?
16:06:12 - Maya Singh: we'll validate. if not we can tune batching, sequence length, and quant profiles. for lower latency we may choose a lower latency model variant or dedicated pool.
16:06:26 - Miguel Torres: question on fallbacks: if Dedicated capacity saturated do you auto-failover to hosted variant?
16:06:33 - David Chen: yes smart routing can fallback to compatible model variants or region and respect policy. we'll document fallback behavior and costs.
16:06:45 - Sarah Patel: any regulatory concerns for having logs cross regions?
16:06:50 - Priya Nair: we need to ensure logs and PHI dont leave region, so region pinning required.
16:06:56 - David Chen: Redwood Private can be deployed in your region/ VPC; we'll make sure storage and logs stay in-region.
16:07:03 - Rachel Ortiz: next steps recap: send onboarding runbook, access form, SOC2 link; customer to provide dataset & network contact; schedule pilot perf window next Monday.
16:07:15 - Sarah Patel: good. i'm going to summarize stakeholders and invite infra to the ticket.
16:07:21 - Miguel Torres: noted.
16:07:24 - Priya Nair: quick question, SSO SAML metadata exchange - who on Redwood should we share with?
16:07:30 - David Chen: send to rachel. she'll coordinate with our identity ops.
16:07:36 - Rachel Ortiz: yes send to rachel.ortiz@redwood.ai (note: actual email will be in calendar invite).
16:07:44 - Sarah Patel: perfect. any blockers?
16:07:48 - Maya Singh: none on our side, just waiting for network + sample.
16:07:52 - David Chen: ok we'll target pilot kick-off 2027-05-24, perf run 2027-05-26 through 27, and a wrap review 2027-05-31.
16:08:05 - Sarah Patel: that timeline works. thanks everyone.
16:08:10 - David Chen: thanks all, i'll follow up with notes.
